name: OpenStock
description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
one_liner: A free, self-hostable stock-tracking website with live prices, price alerts, and company info, like a do-it-yourself Yahoo Finance.
buyer: A fintech content creator or small investment newsletter who wants a branded market-data dashboard for their audience without paying for expensive market-data platform licenses.
business_use_cases: An investing newsletter or YouTuber self-hosts and re-brands it as a free companion tool that drives traffic and email signups.
A local investment club runs it internally to track a shared watchlist without paying for a commercial terminal.
A developer forks it to add premium features (custom alerts, portfolio analytics) and sells it as a subscription product to retail investors.

money_ideas.idea: Fork it, add premium alerting/analytics features, and sell subscriptions to retail investors.
White-label it for finance content creators as a branded 'watchlist' tool that funnels to their paid newsletter.

steal_this: Deploy a re-branded instance for a finance YouTuber's audience this weekend as free lead-gen for their paid newsletter.
